title: CPF Module Schema: Express route port module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-expressrouteport'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 71 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity_ids.description: (Optional) the identity to get the permission of keyvayult secret

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

link1.type: map(object({ admin_enabled = bool macsec_cipher = string macsec_ckn_keyvault_secret_id = string macsec_cak_keyvault_secret_id = string }))
link1.description: "(Optional) The link2 details for express route direct" object ({ admin_enabled = (Required) Whether enable administration state on the Express Route Port Link? Defaults to false macsec_cipher = (Required) The MACSec cipher used for this Express Route Port Link. Possible values are GcmAes128 and GcmAes256. Defaults to GcmAes128. macsec_ckn_keyvault_secret_id = (Required) The ID of the Key Vault Secret that contains the MACSec CKN key for this Express Route Port Link macsec_cak_keyvault_secret_id = (Required) The ID of the Key Vault Secret that contains the Mac security CAK key for this Express Route Port Link })

link2.type: map(object({ admin_enabled = bool macsec_cipher = string macsec_ckn_keyvault_secret_id = string macsec_cak_keyvault_secret_id = string }))
link2.description: "(Optional) The link2 details for express route direct" object ({ admin_enabled = (Required) Whether enable administration state on the Express Route Port Link? Defaults to false macsec_cipher = (Required) The MACSec cipher used for this Express Route Port Link. Possible values are GcmAes128 and GcmAes256. Defaults to GcmAes128. macsec_ckn_keyvault_secret_id = (Required) The ID of the Key Vault Secret that contains the MACSec CKN key for this Express Route Port Link macsec_cak_keyvault_secret_id = (Required) The ID of the Key Vault Secret that contains the Mac security CAK key for this Express Route Port Link })

port_authorization_name.description: (Required) The name of the port authorization

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

azurerm_express_route_port_authorization.description: The authorization key of the express route port.
The authorization use status of the express route port.

azurerm_express_route_port_name.description: The name of the Express route port name

id.description: The ID of the express route port.
